title: did:moltrust Conformance Vector
description: One executable check against the published did:moltrust method specification. The specification is HTML at https://moltrust.ch/did-method-spec.html; section_ref names the section a vector is derived from, so a reader can go from a failure to the sentence it contradicts.

section_ref.description: Section of the method specification, e.g. "2.2" or "4.2".

check.description: syntax = the identifier string alone decides, no network. derivation = the identifier must follow from a public key. resolve = a live request to the registry or the Universal Resolver driver. bridge = section 6, the cross-ecosystem bridge. deployment = whether a running service behaves like the version it reports.

target.description: What answers. 'none' for a check that needs no service. A vector names exactly one target, so a failure cannot be excused by a register entry that belongs to the other one.

public_key_hex.description: Ed25519 public key, 32 bytes as lowercase hex, for a derivation vector.

result.description: CONFORMS for a syntax or derivation vector that should hold. The other four are resolution outcomes.

reason_code.description: The machine-readable code the answer must carry: invalid_did, unsupported_method, did_not_found for the API; invalidDid, notFound, methodNotSupported for the driver.

rationale.description: Why the specification requires this outcome. A failure should be readable without opening the spec.

known_deviation.description: Key into deviations.json. Present when the vector is expected to fail today; the runner reports it and does not fail the run.
